limit: ARRANGEMENT word (it does not end the program: a CLOSING word must still follow it). In each section of S seats, seat at most k guests of category <cat>. All three arguments are required, in this order: category token, k, S.
No table of 7 may have more than 3 investors; tell me each guest's table.
snake: ARRANGEMENT word (it does not end the program: a CLOSING word must still follow it). Reverse the seat order inside every second section (the 2nd, 4th, ...) of S seats.
Every other table of 6 runs in the opposite direction; which table is each guest at?
sectionlead: ARRANGEMENT word (it does not end the program: a CLOSING word must still follow it). In each section of S seats, the guest with the lowest rank number moves to the section's first seat.
At each table of 5, the lowest-ranked guest takes the head seat; tell me each guest's table.
